name: Cardiology
intro: Cardiology is a branch of medicine dealing with disorders of the heart as well as parts of the circulatory system.  Heart disease is the commonest cause of death in Malaysia today.

sections.title: Common Symptons
sections.content:
* Chest pain
* Shortness of breath
* Swelling of ankles or legs
* Blackout

sections.title: Common Treatments
sections.content: Heart conditions can be treated with medication, surgery, or minimally invasive procedures.

name: Ear, Nose, & Throat
intro: Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) diagnoses and treats conditions affecting the ears, nose, throat, and related areas of the head and neck.

name: General Surgery
intro: General surgery focused on non-surgical treatment of conditions involving the abdomen, digestive tract, liver, soft tissues, and endocrine system.

name: Internal Medicine
intro: A physician (internal medicine specialist) treats non-surgical medical conditions by diagnosing illnesses, performing examinations holistically, and advising treatment using medication and counselling.

name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
intro: Obstetricians and Gynaecologists are doctors who specialise in women’s reproductive health. Obstetrics focuses on pregnancy and childbirth, while gynaecology treats conditions affecting the female reproductive organs.

name: Ophthalmology
intro: Ophthalmology focuses on eye health and vision care. In addition to general eye care, the centre also offers subspecialist services such as cataract treatment and low vision aids.

name: Orthopaedic
intro: Orthopaedics focuses on conditions affecting the bones, joints, muscles, and ligaments.

name: Paediatric
intro: Paediatrics manage the health of the children, including physical, behaviour, and mental health issue.

name: Psychiatry
intro: Psychiatry focuses on mental health and emotional well-being. Psychiatrists diagnose and treat mental health conditions using therapy, medication, and ongoing support.

name: Dentistry
intro: Dentistry focused on the teeth, gums, and mouth. Key areas include preventive care, restorative work and specialized fields like oral surgery.

name: Nephrology
intro: Nephrology focused on the care and treatment of kidney diseases. It is a specialty of internal medicine which involves kidney function, autoimmune disease, electrolytes imbalance and renal replacement therapy.

name: Geriatric Medicine
intro: Geriatric medicine is a branch of medicine concerned with the health and illness in elderly, which includes prevention of disease and disability in older people.
